steps.title: Boil it *hard*
steps.text: Assam CTC, water and crushed ginger go on a high flame. Four minutes, no shortcuts, no tea bags.

steps.title: Pull it *high*
steps.text: Milk goes in and we pour from a height, twice, until the chai froths and the spices open up.

items.a: Hot chai doesn't travel well, so we only deliver our blends and kulhad sets. Delivery is free across Mumbai on orders over ₹499.

items.q: Can you do chai for an office or a wedding?
items.a: Yes. We bring a counter, a brewer and kulhads for 50 to 500 people. Message us on WhatsApp with the date.
Ask at the counter. We brew it without sugar and you add jaggery or nothing at all.
